crossRefs.note: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned…
If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…

translations.web: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
translations.bsb: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it, but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
translations.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
translations.asv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
